issues.evidence: Derived from the staffing table. nj_medicaid100 has 100 clients × 83.2 aide hours = 8,320 hours/month. That is about 69 FTEs on the ACA 120-hours-per-month basis, or 48 on a 173-hour basis. Add 1 administrator, 0.75 RN and 2 coordinators. nj_medicaid200 has 16,640 aide hours/month, or about 139 FTEs on the ACA basis. Both exceed the 50-FTE threshold of the federal employer shared-responsibility rule (IRC §4980H). nj_private60 and nj_mixed60 are about 46 FTEs and stay below it.
issues.fix: For nj_medicaid100 and nj_medicaid200, add an ACA large-employer cost: either an offer of affordable coverage or the §4980H penalty. The flat 4% benefits load (which includes paid sick leave) will understate cost. Amounts not verified; get a broker or CPA quote.
